capabilities: Sync reMarkable documents over SFTP or Syncthing
Extract PDF text highlights into Markdown notes with backlinks
Render pen-stroke annotations and notebook pages as PNG images
Browse, archive, delete, and send documents from a library view
Run local handwriting OCR for searchable notebook text
disambiguation: Not general vault syncing between devices; it imports documents and annotations from a reMarkable tablet into the vault.
extras: Enabling Developer Mode for SSH access factory-resets the tablet; the README warns users to back up first. The plugin requires broad permissions (shell execution, direct filesystem access) and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull documents, text highlights, and handwritten annotations from a reMarkable tablet without going through reMarkable Cloud.

relations.evidence: Provides continuous background sync as an alternative to SFTP
E-Ink Sync uses rmscene to parse those files
and PyMuPDF to match highlight coordinates with PDF text
The Search handwriting (OCR) setting needs Tesseract plus two Python packages
Notes written by the pre-rename plugin (which used <!-- remarkable-bridge:start/end -->) are still recognised

summary: Syncs reMarkable tablet documents over SFTP or Syncthing and extracts PDF highlights and pen annotations into Markdown notes, without reMarkable Cloud.
